notes.title: 🔥Alpha to Beta: Escape Purgatory’s Next Chapter🔥
notes.notes:
🎃 [b]Major Update[/b] 🎃

Just in time for Halloween, we’re thrilled to bring you our biggest update yet! With fresh features and a hauntingly improved experience, Escape Purgatory is more terrifying and immersive than ever before. Ready to dive in? Here's what’s new:

🔧 [b]Re-built Menu System[/b] 🔧
We’ve given our menu a full overhaul for a smoother experience! Adjust your FOV, fine-tune audio levels, customize visual effects, and navigate easily with our optimized, user-friendly design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/b9db91c16dbaa35d903465b9c6f7ab1bca2c9966.jpg[/img]

⚒ [b]Revamped Survival Mode[/b] ⚒
Survival mode has been cranked up to keep you on edge! Enjoy new power-ups for more gameplay variety, innovative upgrades to keep you engaged, a brand-new round counter, and an enemy spawning style that brings fresh suspense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/50a8ccf16d84e618753b87b00ed0997931daad9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/4e3781b1f412dfbe6064ec38b4e791698e90f089.jpg[/img]

😇 [b]Unlockable Cosmetics[/b] 😇
Show off your progress in style! Beat Story Mode to unlock the classic Camo Jacket, reach Round 20 for the White Camo Jacket, and for a limited time, play between 10/28 and 11/04 to unlock the holy grail of cosmetics: the Holy Halo!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/ce071ecba0afc1bc2f2a5f38dc7444369c3077cf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/c1b433b39b21d9b23694368911f069663838d1c4.png[/img]

🏆 [b]Steam Achievements[/b] 🏆
Achievements have landed! Test your skills with 20 new achievements in both Story Mode and Survival Mode. How many can you earn?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/90b5d17d6bdda56052999628950c7349ee04bb38.png[/img]

🎮 [b]Partial Controller Support[/b] 🎮
We’re working on enhancing controller integration to improve the gaming experience. Currently, controllers are fully functional in-game, though not yet in the menu system. This is an important focus for us, and we’re committed to delivering full controller support in the near future!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/642002bf3bc2cf47298b5e5675e57b2db2612092.jpg[/img]

😎 [b]New Logo[/b] 😎
Our logo has a whole new look! Collaborating with a professional artist, we’ve captured the essence of Escape Purgatory as it’s meant to be: haunting, dark, and unforgettable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/b2c8f9bb4b5762a02cd79e4b9c669950f01d28f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/3530dc9a61f378c3fbf0e5a5dc0cc7fb2e6f32ee.png[/img]

😱 [b]Live-Action Intros[/b] 😱
Prepare to be greeted by one of four live-action intros each time you launch the game, giving you a spooky preview of the horrors awaiting in Escape Purgatory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/c45f7cfaaa2ecf1fa99162743a32be419088df95.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/859bfdb9fcc743113b3f29a883c4e43628d79087.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/63d49f5a401fecbf34b50243d2e89c6beb7b7b01.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/9e66f1d6a57da9aa1fb21c0c22bb13a197548157.jpg[/img]

🔮 [b]The Road Ahead[/b] 🔮
The future of Escape Purgatory is looking brighter (and scarier) than ever, and we’re beyond excited for what lies ahead. Your feedback means everything to us as we continue to grow and learn. So, can you face the new evil waiting in the shadows?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42129122/d1b80cb8005c4af23e19eea65df7578d6ee6d445.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 🎮 Escape Purgatory Update Now Live! 🎮
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a major update for Escape Purgatory that brings thrilling new features and improvements:

Controller Support: Experience smoother gameplay with full controller integration.
New Weapon - Axe: Wield the powerful axe to fend off enemies and break barriers.
Breakable Crates with Loot: Discover hidden treasures by smashing crates throughout the game.
Crystal Currency: Collect crystals to trade with the mysterious Teddy Bear for valuable items.
Gameplay Improvements: Enjoy enhanced graphics, smoother mechanics, and bug fixes for an even more immersive experience.
Thank you for your support and feedback! Dive back into the eerie world of Purgatory and see what’s new.

Happy gaming! 🕹️🔪👻

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876910/Escape_Purgatory/][img]https://i.ibb.co/WHnFgkk/image.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🎃 Version 0.666 - "Spooktacular Specters & Ghoulish Gobstoppers!" 🎃
notes.notes:
As the shadows lengthen, and the moon takes center stage in the inky night sky, we conjure up something delightfully eerie for you on this fateful Friday the 13th in October. Get ready to dive headfirst into our Halloween-themed update that's sure to send chills down your spine.


[h1]🦇 What's Lurking in the Darkness? 🦇[/h1]

New Haunting Survival Mode: Unearth a host of spine-tingling surprises, from ghastly apparitions to mischievous poltergeists lurking in the darkest corners of the paranormal world. Be prepared to face your deepest fears!

[h1]🎃 Trick-or-Treat Your Way to Victory 🎃[/h1]

Spooky Rewards: Dive into the trick-or-treat experience with our limited-time Halloween event. Collect deviously delicious ghoulish gobstoppers and unlock exclusive Halloween-themed loot that's to die for!

[h1]🕷️ Creep-Tastic Customizations 🕷️[/h1]

Eerie Avatars: It's not a Halloween party without costumes! Battle paranormal entities in their newest collection of creepy customizations. Who says you can't hunt ghosts in style?

[h1]🌙 Beware the Moonlight: 🌙[/h1]

"Be-were" of Moonlit Nights: When the clock strikes midnight--or round ten as we like to say--an eerie transformation sweeps the landscape. The game takes a turn for the supernatural as creatures of the night come out to play.

[h1]🐛 Otherworldly Bug Squashes 🐛[/h1]

Like a good exorcism, we've banished bugs and ghoulish glitches that dared to haunt our game. Your gameplay experience is now smoother than a witch's broomstick ride.

[h1]🍬 A Sweet Update: 🍬[/h1]

Delightful candies, magical scrolls, and ghostly apparitions have added a sprinkle of enchantment to the game.
So, gather your courage, equip your axe, and prepare to confront the unknown! Version 0.666 is our spookiest update yet, and it's just in time for the Halloween season. Your skills will be put to the test as you face the supernatural, trick-or-treat for rare loot, and dress up your character in ghoulish garb. It's a hauntingly good time you won't want to miss!

Download the update now and let the ghostly festivities begin. Who ya gonna call? Your fellow gamers, of course! 💀👻

Happy Haunting and Stay Spooky!

[b]JamBit Games[/b]

notes.title: Let's Escape!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Community!

It is finally here! Today, October 21, 2022, Jambit developers are releasing "Escape Purgatory" for $9.99 and they want you to play! Play as a hopeful "survivor" and make it your sole mission to escape.

Set in a limbo-esk world, this strategic horror game challenges "survivors" to traverse the map while solving puzzles and hunting down artifacts. With each discovery, collect items, repent your sins, and be freed from evil. Can you survive the wickedness within?
